title: PASTP
description: A mod that adds 3 hats (It's made for my friend's Christmas Present and uploaded here for easier download)
body:
This mod adds three hats for players to choose from.

The mushi hat is based of Peggle's leopard gecko. It's an adorable pet to carry around. The steampunk hat is inspired by custom cosplay hats. The mushroom hat is of a red mushroom cap, just like the red mushroom's already in vanilla.
